name: artifact_export
description: Export an Output candidate through SecureArtifactScanner without Host review or result dialogs. Only verified CLEAN bytes are saved to Downloads/SandboxOutput; malware, unavailable scanner and errors are not published. Waits up to wait_ms; completed=false means still processing, so call artifact_list with wait_ms. EXPORTED includes export_path; BLOCKED/FAILED includes result. Repeated requests do not duplicate transfer/publication. Legacy non-Output mode retains its configured approval policy.

reason.description: Purpose of this export, recorded in the audit log.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to this many milliseconds for ongoing Output exports; timeout does not cancel them.
